title: Chapter 90: Battlefield At Night
content:
Chapter 90: Battlefield At Night

"Even if you are allies in the same camp, you should not monopolize the spoils, but should collect and count them together and distribute them according to merit!"

Gou Yin continued patiently.

"This city is the spoils we deserve, and the rest belongs to you. You can distribute them according to merit!"

"So, the nobles must occupy this city?"

"This is the spoils we deserve!"

"Okay! I will report it to the tribe truthfully! Goodbye!"

Gou Yin couldn't persuade the Zerg, and knew that it was meaningless to stay here today, so he could only say goodbye and leave.

He kept in mind the words of the elders, and although he was very dissatisfied, he still restrained himself and did not conflict with the Zerg.

The current combat power of the Tengu tribe here is not absolutely victorious against the Zerg, who don't know how many reinforcements there are.

As for the things in this city, the Zerg can't move them away at once, so they can make long-term plans.

Soon after Gou Yin left, Wu Qing's Zerg clone and the elite of the alliance led by Meng and others rushed to the city occupied by the Zerg.

"You Zerg secretly captured this enemy base city!?"

"The battle was over in one day?!"

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan were all shocked after they briefly understood the situation after they withdrew from the battle!

"In other words, the attack launched by our alliance eventually triggered the camp war, and with the help of the Zerg, the Tengu tribe won?!"

"Haha, this is really interesting!"

"Let's go! Let's go to the front to see the battlefield!"

Meng was eager to go to the front to see the battlefield. He wanted to immediately confirm whether the information Wu Qing told him was true or false.

Zerg puppies could be seen everywhere in the city. Meng estimated the strength of the Zerg and felt relieved.

He asked the Zerg to arrange 5,000 tired alliance elites to rest. He, Yu Chong and Bai Yan followed Wu Qing to the city wall in front of the city, where they could overlook the battlefield of the camp war.

Looking at the tragic battlefield with no end in sight, everyone fell into silence.

Everyone understands that according to the normal trajectory of fate, their final destination is also to fall on such a battlefield, becoming a sharp dust in the scenery that the victor sighs or appreciates.

Wu Qing felt that the atmosphere was a little wrong, so he asked: "It's getting dark, how to deal with such a large battlefield?"

"This place should attract many powerful weirds, right?"

Hearing Wu Qing's question, Meng came back to his senses and sighed: "This scene is really spectacular!"

"There is no good way to deal with such a battlefield, there is only one stupid way!"

"That is to use a large-scale luck formation diagram to cover the entire battlefield!"

"However, on such a large battlefield, the blood and resentment are too strong. Even if there is a luck formation diagram to protect it, it will not be peaceful at night!"

"The Tengu clan will be busy tonight! Bleeding and working hard, haha!"

Meng said with some gloating.

This is similar to the method Wu Qing can think of. After he knew that there was a thing called the luck formation diagram, he had some guesses about the use of the luck formation diagram.

As long as there are large enough or enough luck formations, it is still possible to protect such a battlefield from strange intrusions at the cost of luck.

He thought that there would be a better way to solve this problem in this world, but he didn't expect the result to be the same.

At this time, the logistics personnel and supplies of the alliance rushed to the city under the protection of the Zerg. They have been in the rear without any losses.

Seeing the logistics personnel, Meng thought of Niu Kun, who stayed with the alliance army overnight and drank and ate meat with him yesterday. He knew that Wu Qing knew the intelligence on the battlefield very well, so he asked: "What is the current situation of Niu Kun, the lord of the Niu tribe?"

"It's not clear now. I know that he and his tribe participated in the war, but on the battlefield, the Zerg couldn't get too close. After he went up, he never saw him again."

"Now the Tengu tribe has become wary of the Zerg, and we didn't go close to monitor their surviving troops. I hope he can survive."

Wu Qing told Meng about what he knew.

"I hope so!"

"However, with their identities, they are consumables in such a war!"

Seeing the reality clearly, he will not deceive himself.

In this world, no one knows what he will encounter next. It is the greatest comfort for Niu Kun that everyone here cares about Niu Kun's current situation.

When the sun sets, all the Zerg outside return. This city has gathered nearly 60,000 Zerg, 5,000 elite alliances and some logistics personnel.

Because this is not Wu Qing or the alliance's territory, Wu Qing dispatched nearly 100 hosts here, including 10 one-star hosts, just in case.

With these hosts, in the real crisis, the Queen can instantly descend with powerful spiritual power, enough to deter most enemies.

With the harvest of today's war, the number of Zerg has increased by leaps and bounds, which has made the spiritual power of the collective consciousness of the Zerg explosively increase.

When necessary, it will explode, so that people can see the power of the strong behind the Zerg.

As night fell, an invisible protective shield rose above the vast battlefield, covering the entire bloody battlefield.

The army of the Tengu clan had just experienced a big battle and did not rest. Together with the large number of logistics personnel who entered the battlefield, they had to clean up the battlefield overnight. After all, the luck array was consuming luck every moment, so this time could not be wasted.

"It's about to begin!"

After saying this fiercely, the whole sky turned completely dark. No matter how good your night vision is, the world seems to be seen through a layer of gray fog.

The battlefield with sufficient lighting has become a little dim.

The blood-red substance that was like steam was mixed with a gray-black aura, rising from the battlefield, which was extremely strange.

"With the protection of the Luck Array, why are there still such strange phenomena?"

Wu Qing had been paying attention to the situation on the battlefield, and when he saw this situation, he couldn't help but ask.

"This battlefield is too attractive to the weird, and the dog clan was a little stingy that day!"

Meng said dissatisfiedly.

"This luck formation is different from the lord's protection provided by the lord's scepter. It's a coincidence!"

"Under normal circumstances, it's okay. Normal living people have their own luck, which can be integrated with the luck array, so that the luck array can have an effect similar to that of a lord's protection!"

"This battlefield is full of dead bodies. Not only has all the luck disappeared, but all kinds of auras that counteract the effects of luck have also been emitted!"

"This will greatly weaken the protective effect of the luck array. We need to increase investment in luck to allow the luck array to perform its normal protective function!"

"Looking at the situation on the battlefield, it seems that the Tengu clan has not invested enough luck and can no longer suppress those weird auras!"

"As the strange aura increases, something will happen!"

"These weird abilities are so weird and hard to guard against! If you're not careful, your boat will capsize in the gutter!"

Meng knew that Wu Qing didn't know many common senses, so he patiently explained them.
